title: Issue invoice
purpose: Confirm saved billing details and USD charges, then issue an invoice and store its original PDF.
summary: Review the saved billing details and USD charges before you issue an invoice. The review opens in a dialog over the draft. Issuing locks the draft and stores the numbered PDF.

tasks.title: Issue the invoice
steps: Check the recipient, due date and purchase order in [[Billing details]].
Read the charge descriptions and check the [[Invoice total (USD)]].
Select [[Issue invoice]] at the bottom of the dialog, then select [[Download invoice PDF]] on the issued record.

tasks.title: Use a proposed due date
steps: If [[Proposed due date]] appears, check the date against the saved payment terms.
Select [[Use proposed due date]], then [[Issue invoice]]. Leave the box unchecked to issue without a due date.

tasks.title: Correct the draft before issuing
steps: Select [[Cancel]] to close the review and return to the draft.
Select [[Edit]], update the billing details or charges and save with a reason.
Select [[Review and issue]] and check the current values.

good_to_know: Test, fee and discount descriptions appear on the PDF. Tax assessments print as Tax. The assessment basis or source stays on the staff record.
A saved due date takes precedence. A proposed date goes on the PDF only when you select [[Use proposed due date]].
If someone edits the draft or the proposed date changes before you issue it, select [[Reload preview]] and review the current values.
After issuing, download the PDF and deliver it yourself.

items.label: Draft / Draft ID / Client / Total
items.description: The header identifies the draft, saved client and exact USD total. Only project managers and administrators can open the confirmation or issue an invoice.

items.label: Issue invoice
items.description: The last button of the dialog's action row. Assigns the invoice number, copies the saved billing and pricing details and current laboratory identity, and uses any saved or accepted due date. Stores the original PDF and checksum and locks the draft. The status, due date and attributed history change together. Success closes the dialog and shows the issued invoice. Staff deliver the PDF manually. The issued record also offers Download accounting CSV for the saved charges.

items.label: Cannot issue invoice / Review again / Reload preview
items.description: Issue invoice is shown disabled, with the reason beside it, for a cancelled chain of custody or missing laboratory profile, and after the draft changed under the review. The server checks that the draft is current and active, has 1 to 200 lines and its saved total matches them. If the draft or accepted proposal has changed, select Reload preview (in the dialog header) and review again. A reload clears the checkbox. After a PDF render failure, retry from the preview. A refusal leaves the draft and audit history unchanged.

items.label: Cancel / Close form
items.description: Close the review and return to the draft, unchanged. Opened by its address, the review opens in the same dialog and Cancel goes to the draft. Without JavaScript the review is an ordinary page with the same actions.

items.label: Client name / Account code
items.description: Saved recipient and optional billing account identifier.

items.label: Invoice-to contact / Invoice email / Billing address
items.description: Saved optional billing contact details and address. Staff handle delivery.

items.label: Due date / Payment terms
items.description: An agreed date entered on the draft appears in YYYY-MM-DD and is copied to the invoice. With no saved date, Due date shows Not recorded. The payment terms come from the draft's billing snapshot.

items.label: Proposed due date / Use proposed due date
items.description: An undated draft with saved Net 15, Net 30, Net 45 or Net 60 terms shows a proposal. The proposal adds that many calendar days to the issue date in the deployment's configured time zone. A saved date, blank or unrecognized terms, Prepaid and Due on receipt all suppress the proposal. Check the box to save the proposal on the issued record and original PDF. The box starts unchecked and leaving it unchecked keeps the due date blank. The checkbox sits under Due date, just above the action row, and is offered only while the invoice can be issued.

items.label: Purchase order / Chain of custody / Project
items.description: Saved purchase-order reference, chain-of-custody reference and project name.

items.label: Kind / Description
items.description: Each line is a test, fee, discount or tax assessment. Review descriptions before issuing. The PDF displays staff-entered test, fee and discount descriptions and uses Tax as the description for every tax line. Test lines also show the lab sample ID and any client sample ID.

items.label: Quantity / Unit price (USD) / Amount (USD) / Invoice total (USD)
items.description: Whole-number quantity, signed unit price in USD, its exact extension and the sum of all lines. A tax assessment uses quantity one. Staff review the recorded tax whenever charges change.
